species.tagline: The shark with a hammer for a head

tasks.title: Look at the head
tasks.message: Its head is spread wide like a hammer, with an eye at each end.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a scalloped hammerhead. Its head spreads wide, with an eye at each tip.

tasks.title: Why so wide
tasks.message: Eyes that far apart give it a much wider view of the sea.
tasks.subtitle: With its eyes so far apart it can see across a very wide space at once.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: Clean seas with fish in them are the only place a shark can live.
tasks.subtitle: Sharks need clean water and fish to eat. Thank you!
